upstreamStatement: The project says its released version does not include MLM task weights and requires further pretraining for MLM use.
finding: The downloaded file contains MLM-shaped tensors and loads strictly, but tensor presence and the HF fill-mask label do not establish a correctly trained/matched MLM head. Full forward agrees with the optimized head and still produces implausible fill-mask outputs.
decision: Reject this checkpoint as a ready-to-use zero-shot language scorer. E37 is a model-qualification failure, not evidence against properly pretrained MLM rescoring for Sense.
runner: Default execution stops before model loading. An explicit diagnostic replay flag permits reproducing the rejected checkpoint; it does not qualify it for production.
